name: Esketamine
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: CYP2B6/CYP3A4 N-demethylation forms noresketamine, followed by further CYP processing and glucuronidation. Elimination is mainly urinary as metabolites, with little unchanged parent drug.
